title: financial field rearrange calc
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkProgrammableDataObjectSource with vtkRearrangeFields, vtkArrayCalculator, and vtkAssignAttribute to manipulate financial data fields, then visualize with Gaussian splatting and labeled axes.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkArrayCalculator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkArrayCalculator.html) — computes derived arrays from existing data using expressions.
- [vtkAssignAttribute](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAssignAttribute.html) — assign attribute.
- [vtkAxes](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAxes.html) — axes.
- [vtkCamera](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCamera.html) — camera.
- [vtkContourFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourFilter.html) — extracts iso-surfaces at specified scalar values.
- [vtkDataObjectToDataSetFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObjectToDataSetFilter.html) — data object to data set filter.
- [vtkFieldData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFieldData.html) — field data.
- [vtkFloatArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFloatArray.html) — stores an array of floating-point values.
- [vtkFollower](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFollower.html) — follower.
- [vtkGaussianSplatter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGaussianSplatter.html) — gaussian splatter.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkProgrammableDataObjectSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkProgrammableDataObjectSource.html) — programmable data object source.
- [vtkRearrangeFields](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRearrangeFields.html) — rearrange fields.
- [vtkTubeFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTubeFilter.html) — generates tubes around lines with optional radius variation.
- [vtkVectorText](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVectorText.html) — vector text.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
